# Upstream source material

`NewPipeExtractor-v0.26.5-source.zip` is the complete upstream tag archive from:

https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor/archive/refs/tags/v0.26.5.zip

`rhino-1.8.1-sources.jar` is the published Rhino source artifact from:

https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/mozilla/rhino/1.8.1/rhino-1.8.1-sources.jar

These files preserve upstream licence headers and build/source material for the copyleft dependencies used by this app. They are supplied for source availability; the normal Gradle build resolves the pinned binary artifacts. SHA-256 digests are listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Additional licence texts are in `licenses/`, and the app retains merged dependency licence/notice resources in its APK. See the root `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for attribution and artwork information.
